name: laya-compact
description: Local, offline context compaction: scores every tool call and keeps only what is still needed verbatim. No API key.

scorer.title: Scorer
scorer.description: features = built-in logistic model, no network (measured AUC 0.895 ± 0.073 over ten grouped splits). laya = a local laya-serve sidecar (measured AUC 0.721 ± 0.021 zero-shot on the same splits; use only with a checkpoint fine-tuned on your own sessions).

keepThreshold.title: Keep floor
keepThreshold.description: Probability at or above which a call is never dropped, whatever the reduction target. Raise it to keep more. Measured default: 0.1 retains 84.6% of outputs that were genuinely reused later; 0.5 retains only 5%, because a calibrated scorer rarely exceeds 0.5 when barely 7% of outputs are ever reused.

targetReduction.title: Reduction target
targetReduction.description: Fraction of droppable tool-output characters to free, 0-1. Calls are dropped lowest-score-first until this is met, then dropping stops. Measured: 0.5 frees 42.4% of tool output and leaves 87.5% of the characters reused later; 0.7 frees 52.9% and leaves 79.2%.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Newest messages pinned from compaction; the first message is always kept.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated character reduction, delegate to the built-in summary instead.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a dropped tool result kept, so a wrong drop costs a re-run and not the content.

maxCallStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens per call
maxCallStateTokens.description: Only used when scorer = laya. Must stay under the checkpoint's state budget (768 on multilingual) or the server truncates silently.

phrasing.title: Question phrasing
phrasing.description: Question wording sent to a Laya sidecar: reproducible (default), direct or entailment. Ignored by the built-in scorer, which reads facts rather than wording. Measured over ten grouped splits: on the typed-decisions checkpoint direct reaches AUC 0.721 and reproducible 0.419, so the wording matters more than the checkpoint.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Requests in flight at once while scoring. Default 8. Only meaningful with a Laya sidecar; the built-in scorer answers in microseconds and ignores it.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request timeout ms
requestTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for one request to a Laya sidecar, in milliseconds. Default 30000. A sidecar that accepts a connection and then stalls would otherwise make compaction never return.

minYieldChars.title: Min yield chars
minYieldChars.description: Fewest characters a drop must actually free to be worth making. Default 200. Below this the context saved cannot repay the chance of losing content the session still needs.
